study_design: Post-hoc extension defined before running this comparison, after prior fixed-basis results. No prospective validation.
basis_fit: 384 full-support training images, clean view 0, no targets, equal image weight. Shared fixed position template from supported observations in all 386 training images. Fixed normalized training mean mass.
primary_comparison: k=5, local encoded branch, clean view 0, validation and historical test reported separately. Measure retained position-control advantage, feature MSE, frozen-output drift, and signed Smooth L1 loss change.
secondary: All budgets, both recorded views and branches, per-descriptor and component summaries, component-balanced and leave-one-component-out train basis and template sensitivity at k=5, fixed-mass projection before versus after frozen decoder.
limits: A scalar budget counts 48k image-dependent coefficients plus shared template and basis. No bit-rate, speed, fresh-test, physical measurement or decoder refit claim. Output-first diagnostic uses 96k coefficients.
